research_question: How do positive temperature reserve and spatial heater allocation change low-energy feasible PEMFC cold-start schedules under a common load and operating horizon?
hypotheses_not_assumed_results: First crossing of the melting region may not sustain the subsequent heater-off load.
Increasing prescribed temperature reserve changes energy demand and sensitivity to operating conditions.
Spatial allocation may improve on jointly tuned uniform power and cutoff; either comparison direction is admissible.
Temporal heat profiles may change thermal reserve and electrical output even at matched per-cell energy and cutoff.

reuse_policy.old_results: Forbidden as scientific inputs or caches.
reuse_policy.allowed: Original physical model, solver and parameter assumptions; raw observation workbook.
reuse_policy.execution: All v2 evaluations are new integrations. Existing result IDs cannot be overwritten or loaded by a worker as caches.
reuse_policy.restart: Only the orchestrator may recognize completed v2 IDs to avoid relaunch after interruption; old-study records never satisfy a v2 job.

operating_protocol.thermal_scope: Minimum thickness-weighted MEA mean temperature over all five cells.
operating_protocol.design_assumptions: Declared deadlines, holding duration and temperature reserves are test requirements, not standards or empirically established safety margins.

numerics.absolute_tolerances: Native scaled model.atol; export full vectors.
numerics.jacobian: Supplied active phase-branch Jacobian for fixed heating; exact recipe recorded per job.
numerics.dense_validation: Accepted BDF temperature-polynomial extrema over the specified interval.
numerics.retry_rule: No automatic physical-input changes. Preserve unresolved runs. Numerical retries or implementation corrections use new IDs and amendment records.

search.method: Feasibility-weighted Bayesian search with analytically known auxiliary energy.
search.initial_remaining: Four scrambled Sobol points in each family's bounds.
search.margin_model: Gaussian process with Matern nu=2.5, completed margins only.
search.completion_model: Gaussian-process classifier; unresolved numerical runs excluded.
search.acquisition: max(best_feasible_energy-candidate_energy,0)*P(margin>=0)*P(admissible completion); maximize feasibility probability if no incumbent or no positive acquisition.
search.independence: Each family/reserve/seed chain starts afresh; no cross-chain model training. Seed repetitions are search dependence, not physical replicates.

selection_and_validation.selection: Select the lowest auxiliary-energy feasible candidate in each 32-evaluation chain before viewing refinement outcomes.
selection_and_validation.fine_validation: Reintegrate every selected candidate at r=2 and r=4 without retuning; test the specified reserve without coarse allowance.
selection_and_validation.failed_refinement: Report failure; no silent substitution or retuning.
selection_and_validation.representative_for_perturbations: For each family/reserve select the lower-energy candidate among the two seeds that passes both fine grids. If none passes, mark unavailable.
selection_and_validation.comparison_scope: Best evaluated schedules in finite declared budgets, not global minima or optimizer superiority.

policies: uniform preheating at 1 W/cm2, zero current
uniform concurrent heating at 1 W/cm2, prescribed ramp
first_crossing_and_continuation.continuation: Preserve physical terminal states, zero heaters, 0.30 A/cm2 for 60 s; evaluate dense minima and continuous duration above 0 and 0.01 C.

perturbations.heater_realization_rule: Multiply commands; 1.05 W/cm2 is an actuator perturbation, not an admissible design command.
perturbations.plans: All available family/reserve representatives, no retuning.
perturbations.probability_interpretation: Deterministic stress scenarios without probability weights.

matched_energy_waveforms.plans: Available uniform and spatial representatives for primary reserve 1 C.
matched_energy_waveforms.front_loaded: q_k+delta_k during first half; q_k-delta_k during second half.
matched_energy_waveforms.matching: Same initial state, cutoff and per-cell integrated energy; powers in [0,1]. Report zero modulation at q_k=1.

observation_reproduction.scope: Eight new integrations, including identical columns at -25 C. Calibration-record reproduction, not independent physical validation.

secondary_outputs: thermal storage and local ice diagnostics
reporting_rule: Preserve all evaluations, failures, null margins and refinement outcomes. Draw conclusions after executing this protocol, including null or contrary findings.
